en: Illustrated postcard showing an orientalist view of Egypt. The main scene depicts a group of people in Middle Eastern dress gathered near tents, with a man on a camel in the foreground overlooking a sprawling city of domes and minarets. At the top is the printed caption 'TOMBEAUX DES MAMELOUKS' indicating the Mamluk tombs. On the left inset is a vignette labeled 'Sphinx' showing the Great Sphinx and a pyramid with small figures and camels in the desert. Handwritten cursive text in Italian covers part of the lower right area.
